title: Reduced scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. $X$ is *reduced* if every local ring $\mathcal{O}_{X,x}$, $x\in X$, is a reduced ring (has no nonzero nilpotent element); equivalently, $\mathcal{O}_X(U)$ is a reduced ring for every open $U\subseteq X$.
